doctrine: The user never waits for the system.
note_en: Landvex is server-compute heavy where QUIXZOOM is device-bound, so the budgets sit on the API surface: the time from request accepted to response written, measured on the engine itself with sources in their normal state. Same rules as the QUIXZOOM file — every budget names its measurement point and percentile, an unmeasured budget is never a pass.

budgets.why_en: Pure data. If a client cannot discover the platform instantly, nothing downstream feels fast.
The front door. Interpretation is deterministic and must not feel like thinking.
One place, all indices — the unit a person looks at.
The composing answer a whole role journey ends in.
Sweeps a peer group. Higher budget, but a person is still waiting on it.
Ranks a whole market against itself.
Several markets at once — the heaviest question the platform accepts.
p99, not p95: a cron tick evaluates many watches in sequence, so the tail sets the whole run.

state_rules.event: a source is slow or failing
state_rules.api_may_claim: answer with the remaining sources and a lower data_coverage
state_rules.why_en: Never block a whole answer on one feed. Degrade visibly, never silently.

state_rules.engine_knows: how much of the basis is real
state_rules.api_may_claim: the figure plus its measured share
state_rules.why_en: A fast wrong number is worse than a slightly slower honest one.

state_rules.event: the basis is too thin to answer
state_rules.why_en: Refusing is an answer and must be as fast as answering.
